verdict.rationale: Sandbox0's core offering is an isolated cloud computer where an AI agent can run code, install software and manage files. Outbound network policy and proxy controls can keep it from reaching production services, and brokered credentials keep raw secrets out of the sandbox. Snapshot, fork and rollback let users test against a copy of a known state without altering the original, and the $5 free credit allows trial use. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the isolation, and an explicit test/staging mode for Sandbox0's own API distinct from live billing.
